title: AI与NPC行为异常
description: AI和NPC在任务执行、自主行为、寻路和交互中表现异常，包括不戴头盔出舱、碰撞、卡住、无视命令等，导致玩家难以依赖自动化系统。
evidence: あんまりAIがよくないのでオートにしても効率的に動かないし（床板を一枚ずつ運ぶとか）
my guy walked outside without his helmet for the fun of it
My character will still walk out into space with no helmet on

evidence_items.quote: ramming player, venting player's atmosphere, flinging player into the planet, accelerating player to 2km/s in seconds (when you have 1km/s delta-v)... that's the game's norm for the NPCs.
evidence_items.description: NPC撞击玩家、排放玩家大气、将玩家甩向行星、几秒内将玩家加速到2km/s
evidence_items.quote_zh: 撞击玩家、排空玩家所在舱室的大气、把玩家甩进行星、在几秒内把玩家加速到2公里/秒（而你的速度增量只有1公里/秒）……这就是游戏中NPC的常态。

evidence_items.quote: AI is broken. NPCs sleeping on the floor, drinking water till they are nauseous, stealing your food, denying you docking to one of your ship are just toppings. NPCs walking into fires for food, going into N2-only atmosphere without a helmet, ramming planets, picking fights with police and exterminating police population...
evidence_items.description: NPC行为异常，如睡地板、喝水喝到恶心、偷食物、拒绝停靠、走进火里、无头盔进入N2大气、撞行星、与警察打架并消灭警察
evidence_items.quote_zh: AI是坏的。NPC睡在地板上、喝水喝到恶心、偷你的食物、拒绝让你停靠到你自己的某艘船上，这些还只是开胃菜。NPC为了食物走进火里、不戴头盔进入纯氮气大气、撞向行星、挑衅警察并灭绝警察人口……

evidence_items.quote: the AI priority system is braindead and gets stuck in loops. Characters can’t grab stuff, drop stuff, or put stuff into things.
evidence_items.description: AI优先级系统有缺陷，导致角色卡在循环中，无法抓取、丢弃或放置物品。
evidence_items.quote_zh: AI 优先级系统蠢得离谱，还会卡在循环里。角色没法捡东西、丢东西，也没法把东西放进容器里。

evidence_items.quote: Character AI cannot automate most basic tasks
evidence_items.description: 角色AI无法自动完成大多数基本任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色AI无法自动化大多数基本任务

evidence_items.quote: crew had ai problem that they just didnt work properly
evidence_items.description: 船员AI存在问题，无法正常工作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 船员有AI问题，他们就是没法正常工作

evidence_items.quote: having NPCs deal with their own needs leads to dead NPCs, all the automated things one would expect for a crew to actually manage? They don't do properly, while regularly getting stuck in endless loops leading to their death for one reason or another.
evidence_items.description: NPC处理自身需求导致死亡，自动化管理失败
evidence_items.quote_zh: 让NPC处理自己的需求会导致NPC死亡，人们期望船员能够实际管理的所有自动化事项呢？它们无法正常运作，同时还经常陷入无尽循环，因这样或那样的原因导致死亡。

evidence_items.quote: I have also seen them forget to swap EVA batteries or O2 bottles while working, then stand there gasping.
evidence_items.description: 角色忘记更换EVA电池或O2瓶，然后站着喘气
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我还见过他们在工作时忘记更换EVA电池或氧气瓶，然后就站在那里喘气。

evidence_items.quote: Hauling to designated areas is a mess. Items often end up outside the zone, or even outside the ship, behind the walls.
evidence_items.description: 搬运到指定区域时物品常落在区域外甚至船外
evidence_items.quote_zh: 搬运到指定区域简直一团糟。物品经常最终落在区域外，甚至落在飞船外、墙壁后面。

evidence_items.quote: Automatic hauling is atrocious, including installing parts on the ship. Characters often keep dragging an item even after that item’s job is already supplied
evidence_items.description: 自动搬运极差，角色重复拖拽物品、卡住或把物品拖回原处
evidence_items.quote_zh: 自动搬运简直糟糕透顶，包括在船上安装部件。角色常常会一直拖着一件物品，即使那件物品的任务已经被满足了

evidence_items.quote: my character decides to just cycle an empty battery from his inventory, to the ground and to a wall charger on my ship while under automation orders even after I've manually put a fresh, fully charged battery into the tool he was replacing the battery for
evidence_items.description: 自动化指令下角色反复搬运空电池，即使已手动放入满电电池
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的角色决定只是把一块空电池从他的物品栏里循环搬运到地上，再搬到我这艘船上的壁挂式充电器上，即使是在自动指令下也是如此，而且我已经手动把一块全新的、充满电的电池装进了他正在为其更换电池的那件工具里

evidence_items.quote: my character just straight up ignore his tasks to repair some random part rather than do the work he was supposed to do
evidence_items.description: 角色无视任务去修理随机部件
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的角色干脆直接无视自己的任务，跑去修理某个随机的部件，而不是去做他本该做的工作

evidence_items.quote: the Ai doesn't know how to find a fresh battery for it's equipment, or even how to take it's suit off to use hygiene wipes
evidence_items.description: AI无法为装备找到新电池，也不会脱掉宇航服使用卫生湿巾
evidence_items.quote_zh: AI不知道如何为它的设备找到一块新电池，甚至不知道如何脱下它的宇航服来使用卫生湿巾

evidence_items.quote: the social interactions of the sims-like portion are so convoluted that the AI doesn't know how to manage itself
evidence_items.description: NPC的社交互动AI过于复杂，无法自我管理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 模拟人生式部分的社交互动如此错综复杂，以至于AI都不知道该如何管理自己

evidence_items.quote: you can't order them to just fly the ship for you
evidence_items.description: 无法命令船员替你驾驶飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你没法命令他们直接替你驾驶飞船

evidence_items.quote: NPC are still dumb as all out. Like your crew wanting to walk to a ship you are taking apart, but they don't have a suite.
evidence_items.description: NPC AI很蠢，例如船员想走进正在拆解的飞船却没有宇航服
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC还是蠢到家了。比如你的船员想走到一艘你正在拆解的飞船上，但他们没有宇航服。

evidence_items.quote: hauling is laughably inefficient (you haul one item at a time regardless of your inventory space and there is no *reasonable* item filtering system)
evidence_items.description: 搬运效率极低，一次只搬一件物品且没有合理的物品过滤系统
evidence_items.quote_zh: 搬运效率低得可笑（无论你的物品栏空间有多大，你都一次只搬一件物品，而且没有*合理的*物品筛选系统）

evidence_items.quote: auto-tasking doesn't work properly half of the time
evidence_items.description: 自动任务分配一半时间无法正常工作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 自动任务分配有一半时间无法正常工作

evidence_items.quote: pathfinding still completely fails beyond certain distance
evidence_items.description: 寻路在超过一定距离后完全失效
evidence_items.quote_zh: 寻路在超过一定距离后仍然完全失效

evidence_items.quote: боты на станции заметили пожар и побежали его тушить. Снаружи. Даже те, у кого были скафандры - шлемы не надели
evidence_items.description: AI行为愚蠢，如不戴头盔在真空中灭火
evidence_items.quote_zh: 空间站上的机器人发现了火灾并跑去灭火。从外面。就连那些有宇航服的人——也没戴上头盔

evidence_items.quote: the AI is so broken and dumb when it comes to hauling and repair logic
evidence_items.description: AI在搬运和维修逻辑上表现糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在搬运和维修逻辑方面，AI坏得离谱又蠢

evidence_items.quote: If the base AI was able to swap tools and charge batteries on their own it would almost be forgivable but they can barely eat unsupervised.
evidence_items.description: AI缺乏自主性，无法自行更换工具或充电
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果基础AI能够自己更换工具并给电池充电，那还几乎可以原谅，但它们连无人看管时吃饭都勉强做不到。

evidence_items.quote: Watching NPC stations as the AI has meltdowns and drops tools to rush aboard ships to watch tv is funny the first time and deeply sad the hundredth.
evidence_items.description: AI行为异常，会丢下工具跑去看电视
evidence_items.quote_zh: 看着NPC空间站里的AI崩溃、丢下工具冲上飞船去看电视，第一次看很好笑，第一百次看则令人深感悲哀。

evidence_items.quote: the combat and non-combat NPC AI is very bad
evidence_items.description: 战斗与非战斗NPC AI都很差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗和非战斗NPC的AI都非常糟糕

evidence_items.quote: My character will still walk out into space with no helmet on
evidence_items.description: 角色不戴头盔走进太空
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的角色仍然会不戴头盔就走到太空中去

evidence_items.quote: character is highly unreliable I cant even get other crew due to the issues I have with one
evidence_items.description: 角色高度不可靠，无法获得其他船员
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色极不可靠，由于我在一个角色上遇到的问题，我甚至没法再招其他船员

evidence_items.quote: they will stop doing everything after swapping batteries when needed and wont restart the tasks
evidence_items.description: 换电池后停止工作且不重启任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它们在需要时更换电池后就会停止做一切事情，而且不会重新开始任务

evidence_items.quote: если вы наймете нпс - да, плюс пара рук, но в чем беда то? Если не укажете каждый параметр чертового склада и не поставите автозадачу навсегда  - нпс просто будет существовать
evidence_items.description: NPC不会自动执行任务，除非指定每个仓库参数并永久设置自动任务，否则他们只是存在。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你雇了NPC——是的，多了一双手，但问题在哪儿呢？如果你不指定那该死的仓库的每一个参数，不把自动任务永久设置好——NPC就只是存在着而已。

evidence_items.quote: Crew sometimes won't auto do tasks even with the option enabled.
evidence_items.description: 船员有时不会自动执行任务，即使启用了自动任务选项。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 即使启用了选项，船员有时也不会自动执行任务。

evidence_items.quote: Refined auto-task coding (No, I don't want you to stand there with an empty power drill, PUT your fully charged back-up battery in it!)
evidence_items.description: 自动任务逻辑差，角色拿着空电钻不换备用电池
evidence_items.quote_zh: 改进自动任务编码（不，我不想让你拿着空电钻站在那里，把你充满电的备用电池装进去！）

evidence_items.quote: More often then not they'll just wander away mid conversation or simply fail to give a reply, stalling the convo until it fixes itself.
evidence_items.description: NPC对话中会走开或无法回复，导致对话停滞
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们往往会在对话中途直接走开，或者干脆不给出回复，让对话卡住直到自行恢复。

evidence_items.quote: jobs just stall at the hauling phase after pickup sometimes
evidence_items.description: 任务在拾取后有时会在搬运阶段停滞。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 工作有时在取货后卡在搬运阶段

evidence_items.quote: the Crew AI will continually walk out of the airlocks without a helmet on while on auto-task, forcing you to save them, wasting your time
evidence_items.description: 船员AI不戴头盔走出气闸、拒绝任务等行为持续造成困扰
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在执行自动任务时，船员AI会不断不戴头盔走出气闸，迫使你去救他们，浪费你的时间

evidence_items.quote: instead of actually boarding me they just stay on their ship and do random tasks
evidence_items.description: 海盗强制对接后不登船，只在船上做随机任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们实际上并没有登上我的船，而是待在自己的船上做随机任务

evidence_items.quote: they went from rapidly falling behind me to surging into me in an amount of time that would have turned them into goo
evidence_items.description: NPC飞船无视速度限制突然加速撞向玩家
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它们从迅速落在我后面，到猛冲撞上我，所用的时间足以把它们变成一滩烂泥

evidence_items.quote: Pathfinding errors between two ships forcing the player to babysit huge workloads
evidence_items.description: 两艘船之间的寻路错误，迫使玩家手动处理大量工作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 两艘船之间的寻路错误迫使玩家照看巨大的工作量

evidence_items.quote: Needing to look for your characters shoes because autotask (which isn't even on) ripped through some inventories on an EVA warpath.
evidence_items.description: 自动任务（未开启）在EVA时清空部分库存，玩家需寻找角色鞋子
evidence_items.quote_zh: 需要去找你角色的鞋子，因为自动任务（甚至都没开启）在一次EVA暴走中翻遍了一些物品栏。

evidence_items.quote: the crew ai is kinda borked
evidence_items.description: 船员AI有问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 船员AI有点毛病

evidence_items.quote: Стоит включить высокую скорость времени, как они банально забывают надевать шлем от скафандра и просто задыхаются
evidence_items.description: 船员AI在高时间速度下忘记戴头盔导致窒息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 只要一开高倍时间流速，他们就干脆忘了戴上宇航服的头盔，然后直接窒息而死

evidence_items.quote: The AI is still bad, they will choke themselves to death in space suits, if they are auto-tasked to haul stuff when their hands are full they will walk to the item and then cancel the task
evidence_items.description: AI会窒息、取消搬运任务等行为异常
evidence_items.quote_zh: AI仍然很糟糕，他们会穿着宇航服把自己憋死，如果他们在手已经拿满东西时被自动指派去搬运物品，他们会走到物品那里然后取消任务

evidence_items.quote: Characters that are prone to choosing the way around the ship if they can, doesn't matter if that way happens to go outside and they have no EVA suit on
evidence_items.description: 角色会选择穿过太空的路径，即使没有EVA服
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色如果能够选择绕船的路，就倾向于选择那条路，不管那条路是否会通到外面，也不管他们没穿EVA服

evidence_items.quote: NPC一个比一个抽象
evidence_items.description: NPC行为抽象
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC一个比一个抽象

evidence_items.quote: it's like babysitting a toddler sometimes. having to stop and redirect him every quite often
evidence_items.description: 船员AI差，需要频繁手动操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有时候就像在照看一个蹒跚学步的小孩。得经常停下来把他拉回正轨

evidence_items.quote: my guy walked outside without his helmet for the fun of it
evidence_items.description: 快进时角色会自己走出舱外不戴头盔
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的角色为了好玩没戴头盔就走到外面去了

evidence_items.quote: Half the time the autotask stops working for some inexplicable reason and you have to take care of every persons needs the sims style.
evidence_items.description: 船员自动任务经常停止工作，需要手动处理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一半时间，自动任务会莫名其妙地停止工作，你得像《模拟人生》那样照顾每个人的需求。

evidence_items.quote: Buggy Npcs: (i looted soo many EVA suits from random pedestrians walking out the airlock without a helmet)
evidence_items.description: NPC行为bug，行人无头盔走出气闸
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有Bug的NPC：（我从随机路人身上捡了超多EVA宇航服，他们没戴头盔就走出了气闸舱）

evidence_items.quote: they often choose death instead of being part of this game. But without jokes, many people decide to play without crew at all and not deal with AI
evidence_items.description: AI船员经常选择死亡或停止工作，导致玩家选择不带船员
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们常常选择死亡，而不是成为这个游戏的一部分。但不开玩笑地说，很多人决定完全不带船员游玩，不去应付AI

evidence_items.quote: Security rams into you every time they try to dock, even if it's just for an inspection
evidence_items.description: 安全NPC每次尝试停靠时都会撞上玩家，即使只是检查。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 安保人员每次试图对接时都会撞上你，哪怕只是来检查也一样

evidence_items.quote: crew and NPC behavior still needs a lot of work done for it to not be annoying and borderline dysfunctional
evidence_items.description: 船员和NPC行为仍然烦人且近乎功能失调
evidence_items.quote_zh: 船员和NPC的行为仍然需要大量改进，才能不让人恼火、不至于近乎功能失常

evidence_items.quote: broken as ♥♥♥♥ AI
evidence_items.description: AI严重损坏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 烂得像♥♥♥♥一样的AI

evidence_items.quote: Crew AI didn't improved
evidence_items.description: 船员AI没有改进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 船员AI没有改进

evidence_items.quote: it prioritize things in a non easy to undestarnd way, and there is no control over its priorities
evidence_items.description: 角色AI优先级难以理解且无法控制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它以一种不易理解的方式排列优先级，而且无法控制其优先级

evidence_items.quote: it get stuck doing the same things, it takes in game minutes to figure out what to do
evidence_items.description: AI卡住重复做同一件事，要花游戏内数分钟才决定做什么
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它会卡住反复做同样的事情，要花上游戏内好几分钟才能弄清楚该做什么

evidence_items.quote: When you need a mod so AI can pick up stacks of parts for repairs and they can't grab everything they need to repair or build something at once
evidence_items.description: AI无法一次拿取所有修理或建造所需物品，需要模组才能堆叠零件
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你需要一个模组才能让AI捡起成堆的零件进行维修，而它们无法一次性拿齐修理或建造某样东西所需的一切时

evidence_items.quote: During scheduled work time, NPCs will often ignore orders and just do whatever the hell they want.
evidence_items.description: NPC 船员无视命令
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在预定的工作时间，NPC 经常会无视命令，想干什么就干什么。

evidence_items.quote: talking to NPCs seemed buggy
evidence_items.description: 与 NPC 对话似乎有 bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 和 NPC 对话似乎有 bug

evidence_items.quote: multiple random criminal npc's spawn and beat armed law enforcement officers into the ground by dual wielding briefcases
evidence_items.description: 随机犯罪NPC生成并双持公文包殴打执法人员
evidence_items.quote_zh: 多个随机生成的罪犯NPC双持公文包，把武装执法人员打翻在地

evidence_items.quote: вместо того чтобы подойти к своему зарядному устройству и взять свежую, он бежит на станцию, достаёт из какого-то ящика чужой сварочный аппарат и начинает чинить унитаз на станции. Чо?
evidence_items.description: 自动任务中角色行为异常，如跑去修空间站马桶、不修理残骸
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他没有走到自己的充电装置那里拿一块新的，而是跑到空间站，从某个箱子里拿出一台别人的焊接设备，开始修空间站上的马桶。啥？

evidence_items.quote: Вот он достал батарею и стоит, час игрового времени стоит, два стоит, а дереликт не чинится. А не чинится он потому что корабль большой и болванчик просто "не видит" что ему чинить.
evidence_items.description: 自动修理时角色卡住不动，因为看不到大船上的修理目标
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他拿出了电池然后站着，游戏时间站了一个小时，站了两个小时，可残骸就是修不好。修不好是因为飞船很大，而那个笨蛋就是“看不见”自己该修什么。

evidence_items.quote: after a couple hours and having gone from 100m/s - >100km/s relative to OKLG they are still chasing me
evidence_items.description: AI海盗船在玩家高速移动时仍持续追击数小时
evidence_items.quote_zh: 几个小时后，相对于OKLG已经从100米/秒变成了>100公里/秒，他们仍在追我

evidence_items.quote: they blast towards you at ridiculous speeds and dock with you while travelling >100 m/s which obliterates both of your ships
evidence_items.description: NPC飞船高速撞击并试图对接，导致双方飞船损毁

AI坏到了这种程度：与其下命令，不如全部手动操作来得更省事也更安全。要么就准备好读档吧，因为你自动分配任务的角色会在你打捞到一半的时候不戴头盔就走进了太空真空里。好吧，那就全手动控制。可偏偏美术风格和UI让每一刻都变成一场苦战，才能做成你需要做的事。任务有bug，还会随机消失。性能糟透了，哪怕在配置强劲的电脑上也是如此。这些本来都不算致命问题，但据说这游戏几天内就要以“功能完整”的状态发布了。多年来在抢先体验期间都没解决的问题，不可能几天内就把所有重大问题都处理完。
